That reduces distinct completed tasks count (distinct tasks = number of unique tasks claimed). Since we want maximize distinct tasks, we want A and B to pick different tasks. But we cannot coordinate with A; we must choose a task assuming A also wants to maximize distinct tasks and minimize cost. Both A and B have same objective.
